extensionDescription.message: Finds the accounts signed in to this browser profile and reports them to your AkunMu trees. Never passwords or cookies.

profileEmail.message: Signed in to the browser as $EMAIL$

profileNoEmail.message: Not signed in to the browser with a Google account.

addressHint.message: Your AkunMu address, or http://127.0.0.1:47821 for AkunMu Desktop.

discoverHint.message: Sites outside your providers that look signed in are suggested too.

privacy.message: Only site names and the account names it can read are sent. Never passwords, cookies or page content.

errorAddress.message: Enter an address such as https://akunmu.example.com.

errorKey.message: Paste the whole key; it starts with akm_.

errorUnauthorized.message: The key was not accepted. It may have been revoked.

errorBusy.message: Too many reports. Try again in an hour.

errorServer.message: AkunMu had a problem. Try again later.
